questions.question: Which wearable device(s) are you planning to use for passive data collection (sleep, HRV, activity)?
questions.answer: None yet. But should be written with dependency injection to ensure  that device support can be added easily. Also should be able to manually enter data

questions.question: Should the dashboard support mobile-first interactions (PWA/responsive) or is desktop-primary acceptable for P0?
questions.answer: Both (responsive) but mobile is most important

questions.question: What's the preferred event retention policy - keep all historical data indefinitely or implement retention windows?
questions.answer: Keep all data indefinitely (personal server, storage is cheap, historical trends are valuable). Also a way to manage data from the UI settings (like viewing the size and large files, cleaning all or selected data, etc. - the typical storage management type of things)

questions.question: Should the correlation engine require a minimum sample size before surfacing insights (to avoid spurious correlations)?
options: No minimum, show with confidence warnings
questions.answer: Yes - configurable threshold (from PRD OT-P1-1: "Configurable minimum data threshold before generating correlations")

questions.question: Which domain scenario should be built first alongside the dashboard to validate the integration contract?
questions.answer: Nootropics Tracker (from VISION.md: "lowest friction, immediate value, tight feedback loop", doesn't require hardware purchase)
